title: Buy Clothes
simplified_paragraphs: 昨天上午，我和妹妹去商店买东西了，很晚回家。她买了一点儿水果，我买了不少衣服。我还看见了王先生，他去学开车了。王先生说我买的新衣服很漂亮，我很高兴。
traditional_paragraphs: 昨天上午，我和妹妹去商店買東西了，很晚回家。她買了一點兒水果，我買了不少衣服。我還看見了王先生，他去學開車了。王先生說我買的新衣服很漂亮，我很高興。
pinyin_paragraphs: zuó tiān shàng wǔ， wǒ hé mèi mei qù shāng diàn mǎi dōng xi le， hěn wǎn huí jiā。 tā mǎi le yī diǎn r shuǐ guǒ， wǒ mǎi le bù shǎo yī fu。 wǒ hái kàn jiàn le Wáng xiān sheng， tā qù xué kāi chē le。 Wáng xiān sheng shuō wǒ mǎi de xīn yī fu hěn piào liang， wǒ hěn gāo xìng。
english_paragraphs: Yesterday morning, my younger sister and I went shopping and got home very late. She bought some fruit, and I bought quite a few clothes. I also saw Mr. Wang; he was on his way to a driving lesson. He said my new clothes were very nice, which made me happy.
english_full: Yesterday morning, my younger sister and I went shopping and got home very late. She bought some fruit, and I bought quite a few clothes. I also saw Mr. Wang; he was on his way to a driving lesson. He said my new clothes were very nice, which made me happy.
